# Ligaya Beebe · L. Beebe, LLC

> Ligaya Beebe is an AI enablement consultant based in Estero, Florida, who helps non-technical teams at SMBs and nonprofits go from AI anxiety to AI fluency. She offers hands-on AI training, custom AI agent development, and AI program management. She is PMP certified, a MindStudio Level 3 certified AI agent developer, and has nine years of program and grants management experience in U.S. State Department-funded global education.

The best way to work with Ligaya or talk with her about a role is a free 30-minute call: https://calendly.com/ligaya-b/chat

## Services

- AI Enablement & Training: Custom workshops for non-technical teams, online or in person, cohort or 1:1. Everyone is hands on the keyboard from the first session. Starts from the team's actual work, leaves real time to experiment, and builds lasting fluency rather than a one-day hype session.
- AI Agent Development: Purpose-built AI workflows and agents designed around how a team already works, delivered together with training so the team can use them.
- AI Program Management: Fractional program lead who designs and runs an organization's ongoing AI adoption program, from curriculum to rollout to measurement.

## Learning by building

Ligaya's view of AI adoption: in this AI era, learning by doing means learning by building. Teams need AI skills tied to real workflow results, and organizations should also give people room to try new tools, run experiments, and play. She builds that hands-on experimentation into client engagements and follows the same advice herself. Each project below taught her something she now brings into training.

## Selected work

- [AI Architect Program report](https://1beebe.github.io/ai-architect-program/AI-Architect-Program-Report.html): Peer-led AI learning series she designed and facilitated end to end (2025). What it taught her: a motivated group can run its own semi-structured peer learning, and building alongside others beats building alone.
- [10xcolleges](https://10xcolleges.co/): Live AI college-admissions coach app she built with MindStudio's Remy on top of Yong Tian's open-source counseling skills. It is honest about odds, sources every fact, coaches essays without ghostwriting, and runs spoken mock interviews (2026). What it taught her: pointing a product agent like Remy at an open-source, MIT-licensed repo produced a full app with frontend, backend, and logins in a few hours, and it led her to build with her own team of sub-agents in Claude Code.
- [Marble Descent case study](https://github.com/1beebe/marble-descent): The same tilt-to-roll phone game built twice with Claude, from a 400-word brief with four subagents and from a 70-word prompt. [Play it](https://1beebe.github.io/marble-descent/) on a phone (2026). What it taught her: the 70-word prompt won, with about 20 build steps instead of 132. Clearer asks usually win.
- [Compare Top Image Models](https://app.mindstudio.ai/agents/compare-top-image-models-18755b63): MindStudio hackathon runner-up agent that runs six image models in parallel on one prompt and compares the results side by side. What it taught her: test tools side by side on your own prompt before a team commits to one.
- [Sketch to agent](https://lbeebe.com/videos/reveal-single.mp4): She forked someone else's MindStudio photo-shoot agent and added code-based transition animations, such as a pixel reveal, that she sketched on paper first, to give the static images motion. What it taught her: forking someone's project is a gift, because you see exactly how they built it and can keep iterating on it.
- [Lakoff Lens](https://github.com/1beebe/lakoff-lens): Her first agent, built in January 2026. It analyzes political text for sentiment and metaphorical framing based on George Lakoff's work on framing, and it was aimed from day one at the research method of her father, anthropologist Dr. James Beebe. It wasn't good enough yet, and that was fine.
- [Document Archivist (Archive Intelligence)](https://github.com/1beebe/document-archivist): Five months of building later, the version that works. It turns her father's paper archive into clean, searchable text with structured metadata, which feeds the [qualitative analysis skills](https://github.com/1beebe/beebe-qualitative-skills) she is using to finish his study.
- [AI agent portfolio](https://github.com/1beebe/ai-agent-portfolio): More agents and workflows on GitHub.

## Background

Ligaya spent nine years at iEARN-USA, moving from front-line coordinator for families in overseas programs, to program manager coaching direct reports and international partners, to senior grants manager working with U.S. government funders. Before that she taught at universities in Qinghai Province, China, and was a New York City Teaching Fellow in under-resourced public schools. She has 6+ years of experience building and leading customized professional development programs, and she runs the AI Architect Program, a free peer-learning series inside Never Search Alone.
